narrative.overview: DeepSource-informed neutral charcoal, quiet rules and restrained teal create a compact developer workspace for sustained inspection. System sans typography carries the interface; monospace is reserved for code, paths and event identifiers. The light palette follows the operating system.
keyCharacteristics: Three connected work areas with aligned headings.
Flat tonal surfaces, readable rows and an original SVG identity.
Explicit selection, saving and outcome states.
dos: Do use semantic tokens across both palettes.
Do pair outcome colors with readable status text.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and usable phone touch targets.
Do wrap repository names and source paths within their panes.
donts: Don't imply resizing with decorative handles.
Don't add inert tabs or fictional telemetry.
Don't equate persistence with successful execution.
Don't hide repository context to fit the desktop header.
